taxonomy.name: StackGraph Technical Architecture Taxonomy
taxonomy.description: Canonical job-first taxonomy for architecture coverage, governance, and comparison.

domains.label: Experience & Channels
domains.question: How do humans and external clients interact with the system?

domains.label: Application & Services
domains.question: Where do application behaviour and service responsibilities execute?

domains.label: Integration & Messaging
domains.definition: Boundary crossing through requests, events, messages, and workflows.
domains.question: How do requests, events, and workflows cross boundaries?

domains.label: Data & Information
domains.definition: Information storage, retrieval, movement, and processing.
domains.question: How is information stored, retrieved, moved, and processed?

domains.label: Platform & Runtime
domains.definition: Runtime, compute, network, and managed platform foundations.
domains.question: On what runtime, compute, network, and platform does the system operate?

domains.label: Delivery & Operations
domains.definition: Build, test, configuration, release, observability, and operation.
domains.question: How is software built, tested, released, observed, and operated?

concerns.label: UI rendering & interaction
concerns.definition: Render and update interactive user interfaces.

concerns.label: Web application boundary
concerns.definition: Render, route, and serve web application experiences.

concerns.label: Experience state
concerns.definition: Manage local and remote state consumed by user interfaces.

concerns.label: Input & validation
concerns.definition: Capture and validate user or external input.

concerns.label: Design systems & accessibility
concerns.definition: Provide consistent and accessible interface primitives.

concerns.label: Client channels
concerns.definition: Deliver experiences to browser, mobile, desktop, and embedded clients.

concerns.label: Service & API delivery
concerns.definition: Host request-driven application services and APIs.

concerns.label: Domain & application logic
concerns.definition: Implement business rules and application behaviour.

concerns.label: Persistence adapters
concerns.definition: Connect application models and queries to persistent stores.

concerns.label: Outbound adapters
concerns.definition: Call external services and protocols from application code.

concerns.label: Background execution
concerns.definition: Run deferred, scheduled, or asynchronous application work.

concerns.label: Workflow execution
concerns.definition: Run long-lived and failure-tolerant application workflows.

concerns.label: Application runtime
concerns.definition: Provide runtime and framework hosting for application code.

concerns.label: Edge & API routing
concerns.definition: Terminate, govern, and route inbound network requests.

concerns.label: API contracts
concerns.definition: Define machine-readable service interfaces and interchange.

concerns.label: Service connectivity
concerns.definition: Provide service-to-service traffic policy and connectivity.

concerns.label: Message routing
concerns.definition: Queue, route, and acknowledge messages.

concerns.label: Durable event streams
concerns.definition: Persist ordered and replayable streams of events.

concerns.label: Stream processing
concerns.definition: Process stateful or windowed computations over streams.

concerns.label: Integration orchestration
concerns.definition: Coordinate integration and data movement workflows.

concerns.label: Identity & access
concerns.definition: Provide shared identity, authentication, authorization, and access-policy decisions.

concerns.label: Databases
concerns.definition: Persist and query authoritative application data.

concerns.label: Cache & session state
concerns.definition: Keep reusable or session state close to consumers.

concerns.label: Search & retrieval
concerns.definition: Index and retrieve text, structured, or vector data.

concerns.label: Object & file storage
concerns.definition: Store durable unstructured objects and files.

concerns.label: Warehouse, lake & analytics
concerns.definition: Store and analyse large analytical data sets.

concerns.label: Data processing
concerns.definition: Transform data through batch or streaming computation.

concerns.label: Data movement
concerns.definition: Schedule, coordinate, and move data between systems.

concerns.label: Language & runtime
concerns.definition: Execute application code in a language runtime.

concerns.label: Runtime artifacts
concerns.definition: Package runnable application artifacts and images.

concerns.label: Compute targets
concerns.definition: Provide compute capacity for application workloads.

concerns.label: Workload orchestration
concerns.definition: Schedule and operate workloads across compute targets.

concerns.label: Serverless compute
concerns.definition: Run managed event-driven functions and services.

concerns.label: Network & ingress
concerns.definition: Connect workloads and expose platform ingress.

concerns.label: Cloud & on-prem platform
concerns.definition: Host workloads in managed cloud or on-premises environments.

concerns.label: Build & package
concerns.definition: Transform and package source for execution.

concerns.label: Testing & quality
concerns.definition: Execute automated tests and code-quality controls.

concerns.label: CI/CD automation
concerns.definition: Automate integration, delivery, and deployment workflows.

concerns.label: Infrastructure as code
concerns.definition: Declare and reconcile infrastructure through code.

concerns.label: Configuration & secret delivery
concerns.definition: Deliver runtime configuration and credentials safely.

concerns.label: Release & deployment
concerns.definition: Promote and deploy versioned software releases.

concerns.label: Telemetry & observability
concerns.definition: Capture and operate on logs, metrics, and traces.

concerns.label: Reliability operations
concerns.definition: Detect, respond to, and recover from service failure.
